description.narrative: El objetivo general es contribuir a garantizar la disponibilidad del ComplejoHidroelctrico de Salto Grande (CHSG), aportando confiabilidad y eficiencia a la interconexin entre Argentina y Uruguay.El objetivo especfico es contribuir a extender la vida til del CHSG, mediante la modernizacin de su infraestructura yequipamiento.

The overall objective is to help ensure the availability of the Salto Grande Hydropower Complex(SGHC), enhancing the reliability and efficiency of the interconnection between Argentina and Uruguay. The specific objective is to assist in extending the useful life of the SGHC by modernizing its infrastructure and equipment
